arxiv-2107-02550.title: Universal approximation and model compression for radial neural networks
arxiv-2107-02550.creator: Iordan Ganev, Twan van Laarhoven, Robin Walters
arxiv-2107-02550.description: Abstract We introduce a class of fully-connected neural networks whose activation functions, rather than being pointwise, rescale feature vectors by a function depending only on their norm. We call such networks radial neural networks, extending previous work on rotation equivariant networks that considers rescaling activations in less generality.

arxiv-2310-19589.title: Modeling Dynamics over Meshes with Gauge Equivariant Nonlinear Message Passing
arxiv-2310-19589.creator: Jung Yeon Park, Lawson L.S. Wong, Robin WaltersKhoury College of Computer SciencesNortheastern UniversityBoston, MA 02115{ park.jungy@northeastern.edu , lsw@ccs.neu.edu , r.walters@northeastern.edu }
arxiv-2310-19589.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jung Yeon Park, Lawson L.S. Wong, Robin WaltersKhoury College of Computer SciencesNortheastern UniversityBoston, MA 02115{ park.jungy@northeastern.edu , lsw@ccs.neu.edu , r.walters@northeastern.edu }. Data over non-Euclidean manifolds, often discretized as surface meshes, naturally arise in computer graphics and biological and physical systems. In particular, solutions to partial differential equations (PDEs) over manifolds depend critically on the underlying geometry. While graph neural networks have been successfully applied to PDEs, they do not incorporate surface geometry and do not consider local gauge symmetries of the manifold.

arxiv-2401-04779.title: Influence of plasma on the optical appearance of spinning black hole in Kalb-Ramond gravity and its Existence around M87* and Sgr A*
arxiv-2401-04779.creator: Muhammad Ali Raza, M. Zubair, Eiman Maqsood
arxiv-2401-04779.description: Abstract The visible universe is filled with different types of plasma media in the form of stars, nebulas and other forms of excited gases. These matter fields have a high influence on the gravity and are likely to be present around the black holes due to the immense gravitational attraction.

arxiv-2408-09935.title: Privacy Technologies for Financial Intelligence
arxiv-2408-09935.creator: Yang Li, Thilina Ranbaduge, Kee Siong Ng
arxiv-2408-09935.description: Abstract Financial crimes like money laundering and terrorism financing can have significant impacts on society, including loss of trust in the integrity of the financial system, misuse and mismanagement of public funds, increase in societal problems like drug trafficking and illicit gambling, and loss of innocent lives due to terrorism activities.

arxiv-2408-12474.creator: Sho Tamaki 1,2, Mads Bjerregaard Kristensen 1,2, Théo Martel 3, Rémy Braive 3,4,5, and Albert Schliesser 1,2,*, Sho Tamaki, Mads Bjerregaard Kristensen, Théo Martel, Rémy Braive, and Albert Schliesser, Sho Tamaki 1,2, Mads Bjerregaard Kristensen 1,2, Théo Martel 3, Rémy Braive 3,4,5, and Albert Schl
arxiv-2408-12474.description: Abstract Faithful quantum state transfer between telecom photons and microwave frequency mechanical oscillations necessitate a fast conversion rate and low thermal noise. Two-dimensional (2D) optomechanical crystals (OMCs) are favorable candidates that satisfy those requirements. 2D OMCs enable sufficiently high mechanical frequency (1 ∼ \sim 10 GHz) to make the resolved-sideband regime achievable, a prerequisite for many quantum protocols.

arxiv-2502-10493.title: Pulsational characteristics of mass accreting stars in close binary systems Volume: 50 Affiliation: Nicolaus Copernicus Astronomical Centre, Polish Academy of Sciences Bartycka 18, PL-00-716 Warsaw, Poland Email: amiszuda@camk.edu.pl
arxiv-2502-10493.creator: A. Miszuda \orcid 0000-0002-9382-2542
arxiv-2502-10493.description: Abstract Eclipsing binaries with pulsating components are a distinct subclass of binaries, merging orbital and pulsational analyses. In recent years that subclass led to the definition of a newly formed branch of tidal asteroseismology. While single-star pulsators are well understood, the effects of binarity and possible mass transfer on pulsational characteristics, particularly in mass-gaining stars, remain to be systematically explored.

arxiv-2510-09951.title: Egocentric Visual Navigation through Hippocampal Sequences
arxiv-2510-09951.creator: Xiao-Xiong Lin, Yuk Hoi Yiu, Christian Leibold
arxiv-2510-09951.description: Abstract Sequential activation of place-tuned neurons in an animal during navigation is typically interpreted as reflecting the sequence of input from adjacent positions along the trajectory. More recent theories about such place cells suggest sequences arise from abstract cognitive objectives like planning.

arxiv-2510-13329.title: Embedding-Based Context-Aware Reranker
arxiv-2510-13329.creator: Ye Yuan, Mohammad Amin Shabani, Siqi Liu
arxiv-2510-13329.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ye Yuan, Mohammad Amin Shabani, Siqi Liu. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems rely on retrieving relevant evidence from a corpus to support downstream generation. The common practice of splitting a long document into multiple shorter passages enables finer-grained and targeted information retrieval. However, it also introduces challenges when a correct retrieval would require inference across passages, such as resolving coreference, disambiguating entities, and aggregating evidence scattered across multiple sources.

arxiv-2511-18149.title: Coherence of quantum non-Gaussian states via nonlinear absorption of quanta
arxiv-2511-18149.creator: Kingshuk Adhikary, Darren W. Moore, Radim Filip
arxiv-2511-18149.description: Abstract The linear and phase insensitive absorption of a single quanta via coherent interactions with a saturable system, even a single ground state qubit, is sufficient to deterministically generate quantum non-Gaussian states in an oscillator, even stimulated merely by increasing thermal oscillator energy. However, the resultant states only approach Fock states and therefore do not exhibit quantum coherence.

pmc-10637666.creator: Ingrid Garcia De Sena, Adalberto Veronese da Costa, Isis Kelly dos Santos, Dayane Pessoa de Araújo, Francisca Tayná da Silva Gomes, José Rodolfo Lopes de Paiva Cavalcanti, Maria Irany Knackfuss, Micássio Fernandes de Andrade, Paloma Katlheen Moura Melo, Ivana Alice Teixeira Fonseca, Michael Francis
pmc-10637666.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundTo determine the feasibility and effect of high-intensity interval training (HIIT) in individuals with Parkinson’s and their effect on symptom modification and progression.MethodsWe conducted this systematic review following the Preferred Reporting Items for systematic review and meta-analysis (PRISMA). All studies were searched in seven databases: MEDLINE (PubMed), Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, Web of Science, EMBASE, SPORTDiscus, Virtual Health Library (VHL) and SCOPUS in September 2020 and updated in June 2023.

pmc-10723589.creator: Suhua She, Yulong Shen, Kun Luo, Xiaohai Zhang, Changjun Luo
pmc-10723589.description: BackgroundAcute kidney injury (AKI) is prevalent in patients with intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) and is associated with mortality. This study aimed to verify the predictive accuracy of different machine learning algorithms for AKI in patients with ICH using a large dataset.

pmc-11565368.title: Anticoagulant therapy in adult with COVID-19: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trial
pmc-11565368.creator: Yanan Zhou, Yanping Yang, Ying Wang, Dongni Hou, Yuanlin Song
pmc-11565368.description: BackgroundBlood coagulation dysfunction is a risk factor for adverse outcomes in patients with coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19), especially in severe cases. The evidence for the effects of anticoagulation therapy on prognosis of COVID-19 patients and its risk of causing bleeding events is accumulating.

pmc-11637245.title: Predictors of advance care planning in 11 high‐income nations
pmc-11637245.creator: Preshit N Ambade, Zachary T Hoffman, Kaamya Mehra, Neil J MacKinnon
pmc-11637245.description: BackgroundElderly population is increasing in high‐income countries. For instance, by 2050, 21.4% of the United States population is expected to be 65+, thus making advance care planning (ACP) increasingly important. We aim to identify predictors of ACP completion in 11 high‐income countries and explore relationships between ACP and utilization factors.

pmc-11673252.title: Effects of Hydrogen Sulfide at Normal Body Temperature and in the Cold on Isolated Tail and Carotid Arteries from Rats and TRPA1 Knockout and Wild-Type Mice
pmc-11673252.creator: Leonardo Kelava, Eszter Pakai, Kazushi Ogasawara, Kata Fekete, Gabor Pozsgai, Erika Pinter, Andras Garami, Sandra Lia Amaral
pmc-11673252.description: Background: Hydrogen sulfide (H2S) is a gasotransmitter that modulates vascular tone, causing either vasodilation or vasoconstriction depending on the vascular bed, species, and experimental conditions. The cold-sensitive transient receptor potential ankyrin-1 (TRPA1) channel mediates H2S-induced effects; however, its contribution to the vasomotor responses of different arteries at different temperatures has remained unclear.

pmc-12362870.title: Don’t put words in my mouth: speech perception can falsely activate a brain-computer interface
pmc-12362870.creator: Anouck Schippers, Mariska J. Vansteensel, Zac V. Freudenburg, Shiyu Luo, Nathan E. Crone, Nick F. Ramsey
pmc-12362870.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundRecent studies have demonstrated that speech can be decoded from brain activity which in turn can be used for brain-computer interface (BCI)-based communication. It is however also known that the area often used as a signal source for speech decoding BCIs, the sensorimotor cortex (SMC), is also engaged when people perceive speech, thus making speech perception a potential source of false positive activation of the BCI.

pmc-12396107.title: A case report of fulminant eosinophilic myo-pericarditis related to checkpoint inhibitors complicated by acute heart failure and cardiac tamponade
pmc-12396107.creator: Yaqub Betz, Selveras Zayed, Francesco Moroni, Robin LeGallo, Antonio Abbate, Helle Søholm, Tamas Alexy, Shahana Alasgarli, Alaeldin Addas, Deepti Ranganathan
pmc-12396107.description: BackgroundImmune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) have revolutionized cancer treatment but are associated with various adverse effects, including myocarditis, with mortality rates up to 50%. We report a case of fatal ICI-related fulminant eosinophilic myo-pericarditis complicated by tamponade in a 69-year-old man with metastatic lung adenocarcinoma.

pmc-12471444.title: Multi-Focus Imaging and U-Net Segmentation for Mesoscale Asphalt Film Structure Analysis—Method for Characterizing Asphalt Film Structures in RAP
pmc-12471444.creator: Ying Wang, Shuming Li, Weina She, Yichen Cai, Hongchao Zhang
pmc-12471444.description: This study presents a high-fidelity image acquisition method for asphalt film structure to address the challenge of capturing mesoscale structures, especially fine mineral filler and asphalt mastic. The method is particularly applied to the analysis of the mortar structure in reclaimed asphalt pavement (RAP) mixtures.

pmc-12743255.title: ﻿Diversity of silica-scaled chrysophytes (Chrysophyceae) from Mindanao Island (Philippines) with the description of Mallomonas pseudopustula sp. nov.
pmc-12743255.creator: Evgeniy S. Gusev, Marina E. Ignatenko, Chris Rey Lituanas, Kyla Rose Gumapac, Nikita A. Martynenko, Boris D. Efeykin
pmc-12743255.description: ﻿AbstractThis study presents the first comprehensive investigation of chrysophytes from the Philippines. The flora of silica-scaled chrysophytes from freshwaters of Mindanao Island has been studied by means of scanning and transmission electron microscopy. A total of thirty-six taxa were recorded, including three belonging to Paraphysomonas, two to Spiniferomonas, one to Lepidochromonas, twenty-nine to Mallomonas and one to Synura.

pmc-12772220.title: A PSAT1 buff of YBX1 transcriptionally sustains HLA-E-mediated evasion of NK immunity
pmc-12772220.creator: Yangyi Zhang, He Ren, Chaobing Ma, Changhong Shi, Ruigang Yang, Chenxi Wang, Pengfei Feng, Bo Zhang, Chenyu Liu, Zubiao Niu, Yalan Yang, You Zheng, Zhuoran Sun, Ying Zhang, Shinan Zhang, Gerry Melino, Hongyan Huang, Qiang Sun
pmc-12772220.description: SignificanceDespite advances in immunotherapy, immune-cold tumors remain a clinical challenge due to their suppressive microenvironment. This study reveals that phosphoserine aminotransferase 1 (PSAT1) promotes tumor progression through a nonautonomous mechanism, i.e. sustaining HLA-E expression to evade natural killer (NK) cell immunity. A molecular buff, consisting of PSAT1, MARK2 and YBX1, was identified for HLA-E.

pmc-13332030.creator: Keren Wood, Nicholas Schnorbus, Luis Muncharaz, Yash Lahoti, Brent A. Siesky, Giovanna Guidoboni, Alice Verticchio Vercellin, Samuel Potash, Lily A. Greenberg, Michael Atlan, Toco Y. P. Chui, Richard Rosen, Alon Harris
pmc-13332030.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The retinal microvasculature is one of the few sites where the microcirculation can be directly and non-invasively visualized in vivo, offering a unique window into ocular disease and systemic health. In this study we developed and validated a novel imaging platform integrating a custom-built one-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) with laser Doppler holography (LDH), a high-speed imaging technique that captures Doppler-induced phase shifts, for real-time cardiac cycle-resolved assessment of retinal hemodynamics.

pmc-13362563.title: N-Acetyl-L-Cysteine as a Potential Adjunctive Strategy in STEC-HUS: Mechanistic Rationale and Current Evidence
pmc-13362563.creator: Joanna Wróblewska, Marcin Wróblewski, Alina Woźniak
pmc-13362563.description: Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli (STEC) infections are a major cause of hemolytic uremic syndrome (HUS), a thrombotic microangiopathy characterized by microangiopathic hemolytic anemia, thrombocytopenia, and acute kidney injury. The pathogenesis of STEC-HUS is primarily driven by Shiga toxins (Stx), which induce endothelial injury, inflammation, platelet activation, and microvascular thrombosis.
